title.narrative: Building resilience and social responsibility in rural communities in Abkhazia - European Neighbourhood Programme for Agriculture and Rural Development (ENPARD IV)

description.narrative: The action aims at improving socio-economic conditions of the rural population in Abkhazia, through increased economic opportunities and sustainable management of natural resources with a focus on agriculture. It builds upon the lessons learned from previous ENPARD and rural development initiatives in Abkhazia.
